title: Pell's Listening Wire
warm:
Pell's listening wire rode under [player_name]'s clothes into Marcus Pell's office like soft recorder courage with a pulse—early thirties across-the-hall neighbor-mistress wearing Layer 7 risk while Nolan Greer stayed seated under inquiry elsewhere. Detective Imani Brooks would call this gold or obstruction. Vivienne's four fates stayed open: willing leave, paid vanish, dead, staging. Rhea Quinn's ash had pointed toward fixer mouths. Soft alibi had become wire.

"Traveling," Pell said, polishing the word until it reflected nothing. Finance holding shadow, NDA typeface in his smile. "Soft cooperation still serves everyone if you remember which doors stay closed."

[player_name] felt the recorder against her skin like a second heartbeat. Wine rings memory. Elevator chime far in Crownspire shafts. Black car downstairs. Unused perfume she should not know. Hope and dread shared the office carpet. Soft meant pliable; wire meant pliability had teeth pointed both ways.

She catalogued Pell's language: planes, absences, methods that rhymed with silent-partner paper without settling Vivienne. Weekly to monthly to gone lived in every polite sentence. No settled corpse. Brooks's colder file waiting outside.

"Risk being made," the choice whispered, "if the wire fails in his ear." Or speak night-truth later—bring the gap into Nolan's bed after soft listening either succeeded or burned. Neither settled Vivienne. Both spent Layer 8.

Choice verbs waited: made, or night-truth. Crownspire held its hush above glass. Soft alibi had stopped being only cover the moment she walked wired into Pell.
hot:
Listening-wire heat meant soft recorder against [player_name]'s early thirties ribs while Marcus Pell polished traveling—and her body still ached for Nolan Greer's mid-forties mouth elsewhere under inquiry. Rain-money memory. Vivienne's perfume as third heat. Brooks colder without corpse. Nipples tight under silk hiding wire; thighs tight around unfinished climax. Crime plot; intimacy romance-locked on Nolan, never gore, never Pell as heat.

"Risk being made," her pulse said, "or carry night-truth to Nolan after. Both leave you wet for the man who isn't in this office. Neither boxes Vivienne."

Four fates open. Mid-want ending first. Elevator chime in memory. Romance locked. Unfinished on purpose. Soft alibi heat ended on made-or-night-truth verbs.
